about_short_description.short_description: Udhaar App is an online ledger that helps manage credit (Udhaar) with customers and suppliers.

product.name: Udhaar Book Digital Khata
product.description: A digital ledger app for managing credit transactions, sales, and payments between businesses and customers.

product.name: Cash Book Management
product.description: A feature to track business income and expenses in real-time, categorizing transactions for clear financial oversight.

product.name: Inventory Management (Stock Book)
product.description: A tool to track inventory levels, manage stock details, and receive low stock alerts to prevent stockouts.

product.name: Staff Payroll Management
product.description: A system to automate payroll processes, including attendance, overtime, advance payments, and salary disbursement.

product.name: Digital Invoicing (Bill Book)
product.description: A feature to generate, customize, and send digital invoices to customers via SMS or WhatsApp.

product.name: Sale POS (Point of Sale)
product.description: A system to record sales transactions instantly, update inventory, and track daily sales progress.
